title: The Jellyfish That Can Reverse Its Age
description:
This jellyfish can take a different route through life.

Turritopsis dohrnii can reorganize from a swimming medusa through a cyst-like stage into polyps. The colony can then bud new jellyfish. Predators can still kill it, and reversal does not guarantee survival.

Original biological illustration; development is time-compressed, not microscopy. Synthetic narration; original sound.

Sources:
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6893190/
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9459311/
